name: Jonas/John (Peter's father)
title: The Apostle Peter's Father
summary: Jonas (also called John) was the father of the apostle Peter and his brother Andrew. He was a fisherman from Bethsaida by the Sea of Galilee, and although he does not play a prominent role in the Gospels, he is known through references to Peter as 'Simon, son of Jonas/John'.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Peter's father at the confession
keyEvents.description: When Peter confessed that Jesus was the Messiah, Jesus called him 'Simon, son of Jonas', confirming his father's name.

keyEvents.title: Jesus asks Peter about his love
keyEvents.description: By the Sea of Galilee after the resurrection, Jesus addresses Peter as 'Simon, son of John' three times when restoring him.

keyEvents.title: Peter's calling at the introduction
keyEvents.description: The Gospel of John identifies Simon Peter as the son of John when Andrew first brings him to Jesus.
